title: DEL-Flow generative model designs MDM2-p53 macrocyclic peptide inhibitors, tested in vitro
summary: DEL-Flow, a pocket-conditioned SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching generative model trained on DNA-encoded-library selection signals, generated 40 macrocyclic peptide candidates for MDM2. Two synthesized candidates, 126-18 and 319-18, inhibited the MDM2-p53 interaction with IC50 1.95 and 6.50 uM and Ki 163 and 548 nM. Only two of 40 candidates are reported tested, potency is micromolar, and hit rate, negative controls and counter-screens are not stated in the abstract of this ChemRxiv v1 preprint.
ai_technology: DEL-Flow pocket-conditioned SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching generative model with MASK denoising trained on DEL selection signals
organization: Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: Off-DNA synthesis and fluorescence-polarization assays of generated macrocyclic peptides against MDM2-p53.
evidence.unknown: Hit rate among the 40 candidates, negative controls and counter-screens; peer-review status; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A generative flow-matching model proposed macrocyclic peptide side-chain variants conditioned on the MDM2 pocket.
